text:
```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run Claude Code for issue triage
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an issue triage assistant. Analyze the issue description and suggest appropriate labels from the repository's label set. Output a JSON array of labels to apply.
          mcp_config: |
            {
              "issue_operations": true
            }
          max_turns: 3
          anthropic_model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          claude_env: production
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Add labels to issue
        uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@18f1af5e3544586314bbe15c0273249c770b2daf
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          labels: ${{ steps.claude.outputs.conclusion }}
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
```
